description: Realtor tool: requires Authorization: Bearer with an API key (create one at fless.io/realtor under API keys); anonymous calls return the structured UNAUTHORIZED error. Create a hunt FOR one of your clients (fields mirror get_hunt_requirements). Returns hunt_id + matched_count; the hunt parks at awaiting_realtor_curation. Gated on an active subscription/trial.

client_email.description: Alternative to client_user_id: the client's linked email

client_user_id.description: Your client's user id (realtor_list_clients). Provide client_user_id OR client_email.

proximity_criteria.description: POIs the hunt centers on (name, latitude, longitude, category?, max_distance miles 0.1-10)

name: realtor_create_hunt
